outcome: time from birth to spontaneous breathing
time from birth to cord clamping
time from birth to initiation of bag mask ventilation (BMV)
need for chest compression and/or adrenalin
cohort: The study observed 496 neonates delivered in two referral hospitals.
finding: The majority of neonates (83%) initiated spontaneous breathing soon after birth, and BMV was initiated within the Golden Minute (60 seconds) in most neonates requiring it, suggesting that HBB training is retained and applied by HCP.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered by cesarean section took longer to initiate their first breath compared to those delivered vaginally (median time 19 seconds vs. 14 seconds).
birth_weight: neonates with low birth weight (birthweight < 2,500 g) were more likely to require BMV
